snippet.title: Age of Wonders 4 Expansion Pass 2 Reveal - Archons are back! | New Content
snippet.description:
Prepare for the next evolution of Age of Wonders 4 as new Expansion Pass is now available!  Available for purchase today on PC, PlayStation®5, and Xbox Series X|S consoles, the new Expansion Pass will include four content releases in a single bundle, with the first DLC “Herald of Glory” available immediately. Moreover, the new Content Pack Ways of War will be available in a month on Novermber 5th!

Learn more: https://pdxint.at/aow4-ep2
